Tasty Chef — is a restaurant management simulator in which the player is both the owner and the main employee. You must independently plan work areas, purchase ingredients, manage the warehouse, and prepare dishes step by step, trying to serve customers before the order queue becomes too long. Download Tasty Chef You can use a torrent on your PC to create your own restaurant, set up your kitchen, and organize the smooth operation of the entire establishment.

Restaurant kitchen

The layout of the space directly impacts workflow, so the flexible placement of equipment, worktables, and storage areas allows you to design your own kitchen layout. As the restaurant grows, you can expand by adding new areas and improving the layout of essential items. It's important to plan the flow between workstations in advance to ensure smooth food preparation and service, especially when orders begin to increase rapidly.

The menu also depends entirely on the owner's decisions. As you play, new recipes are unlocked, allowing you to choose those suitable for the current day and remove unnecessary dishes from the menu if desired. Each recipe requires its own sequence of actions: ingredients must be prepared, the appropriate equipment must be used, all preparation steps must be completed, and the finished food must be delivered to the waiting guest. Later, some responsibilities can be delegated to hired staff, who will take orders, prepare food, serve customers, and manage inventory.

Features of the game

Open-plan restaurant Creating your own menu Step-by-step cooking Hiring employees for various tasks

Installation:
1. Unpack the archive (make sure the folder path has Latin characters only).
2. Run the game.
